states.changed: The work exists: seventy health zones of the Congo outbreak stand as mounds on a 3D field, fog stands only where the file wrote suspicion and a haze where it wrote a national count of open suspects, and running the record carries the field from thick haze in May to perfect visibility from August while the mounds keep rising, with lamps at 42 quiet days, red rings where a case followed, black no-report days, the reports' province suspicion as a band on the horizon, and wind that blows only with the fog.

The field now lies on the land: every health zone of the region drawn from its boundary, the file's 69 on their own ground greening with quiet and 280 dark and never written, under national borders; the zone the file names only NA hangs in the air with no place; and across the border Nairobi rises from 6 October with fog that never lifts, because Kenya kept writing its contacts.

Once the file stops writing doubt the land fills with flickering static and a hiss, where the ground used to green; a ruled amber wall stands around the field on the days the reports tabled suspicion; no-report days black out; and the run stops on 30 May, 4 August and 9 October to say what the record changed, with 9 October landing as a flash, a thud and a jump of every mound.
